activity.notes: Maharana Pratap (Rana Pratap Singh) ruled Mewar from 1572 until his death in 1597 and is especially associated with continued Mewar resistance to Mughal expansion under Akbar. ATLAS reuses the existing Kingdom of Mewar polity.

sources.title: Rana Pratap Singh — Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Rana Pratap Singh as the maharaja of Mewar from 1572 to 1597 and records his death on 19 January 1597.
